_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 89: 8-9 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw burning of buildings that looked like when COVID was going on, with rioting and stealing, and is reminded that he was told to pray over the Senate, agreeing and saying to pray over the Senate, the House and the elections coming up, for elections too big to rig and fair elections, and mentions a map his son brought out of all these states.
mentions.quote: Pray over the Senate, the House, and and the elections coming up
mentions.falsify_match: Rioting and building fires around the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet election. Looked like when COVID was going on gives a comparison rather than a threshold, and no city or scale is named.

mentions.claim_text: He works out the time remaining aloud, saying it is not six months because it is not the whole month of November, so basically five months or not even that, four and a half months after this week until the next major election, that it is coming quick and November will be here before they know it, that it is the first week of November, and that they have to start praying.
mentions.quote: November will be here before we know it. It's the first week
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: counting the weeks to a scheduled election.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Nothing is forecast; the date comes from the electoral calendar.

mentions.claim_text: He says you cannot do it with one drop but as the rain begins to fall and praises go before him the river will flow and move the obstacles out of your life, that it will pick up the biggest boulders and the biggest burdens and remove them though they seem to have been stuck for years, and voices someone saying they cannot get around it and the Lord answering that he does not need them to get around it.
mentions.quote: the river will flow and move those obstacles out of your life
mentions.condition_text: if the praises go before him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: obstacles and burdens are not specified.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that it shall rise as the dew and the glory of the Lord will rise, then sings a repeated refrain calling the river to flow out through the nations wherever man may go, and thanks the Lord.
mentions.quote: And it shall rise as the dew. The glory of the Lord will rise

mentions.claim_text: He says the man is going to be in Fort Worth, Texas in October and will upload his itinerary hopefully next week, that they spoke to his wife and they have not had time to upload all the services they are doing in the fall, that he really wants to go to some of those and looks forward to being in the presence of the Lord, and recalls the conversation about coming to Tulsa.
mentions.quote: going to be in Fort Worth, Texas in October
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: someone else's published meeting schedule.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has never been to Malibu but it sounds pretty, that the Lord said a major shaking is coming and it will be signs and wonders following, and that he is believing that with Mel Gibson's new Passion of the Christ film coming out next year they are going to see a great harvest of souls come from it.
mentions.quote: we're going to see a great harvest of souls come from the Passion
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions attributed to the film after its release.
mentions.falsify_miss: None workable: great harvest has no number attached. He marks it as believing rather than seeing, and the release itself is a scheduled public event rather than something shown to him. The year has moved from 2026 to 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says something blots out the sun and that he said it is going to start to affect the migration of the birds and the breeding of the animals so they will not know what is going on, that he saw birds thinking it is fall and starting to breed in August instead of October, and that the Lord said it throws things off and there is about to be an event that throws things off.
mentions.quote: I saw birds thinking fall and they start breeding in August instead of October
mentions.falsify_match: Documented out-of-season breeding in bird populations attributed to a solar event.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such reports. This is unusually testable for a claim in this corpus: bird breeding seasons are recorded systematically by ornithologists, so an off-season shift would show in the data or not.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned them this was going to happen on April 1st, that major fireballs are going to start coming into the atmosphere and start breaking windows and houses and cars, is told a 3.5 hit California and answers that the one he saw is bigger, and notes reports of solar disruptions.
mentions.quote: major fireballs are going to start to come into the atmosphere
mentions.falsify_match: Meteor events causing property damage after the April word.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. The one I saw is bigger is the move to watch: a real event of the named kind arrives, is too small to count, and the claim is held open for a larger one.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a major tour and asks when this happened, is told today, thanks God for protecting Sister Billy, says he was sending them there for a prayer mission because a surprise attack was coming to northern Israel, that he said a surprise attack was coming and was sending them there to pray, and that he saw an attack coming worse than October the 7th.
mentions.quote: He said a surprise attack was coming and he was sending them there to pray
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack on northern Israel during that trip.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurred. The trip is a real, dated, verifiable thing, so whether the stated reason for it was given in advance is checkable against the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them try to assassinate the man in the days ahead and that it was successful and he saw it for that man, that he saw a shaking in Ukraine and saw Kiev divided into two, asks what will happen out of this and what the plan is and says it is very interesting to him, and establishes that it happened today, June 7th.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking and Kev Kiev was divided into two
mentions.falsify_match: The Ukrainian leader assassinated and Kyiv partitioned.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. He says outright that the assassination was successful, which is unusually unhedged for this corpus and leaves no room for a prayer-averted reading.

mentions.claim_text: He says a Watergate Nixon scandal will come again concerning the 2028 election and that he said a Watergate scandal will come, asks for the picture to be shown sometime, and says he saw Emmanuel Macron and saw all these other nations censoring him, which causes major financial disruption in X and other social media platforms, though he did not see it with Facebook.
mentions.quote: I saw all these other nations censoring him and it causes major financial disruption
mentions.falsify_match: European action against X causing measurable financial damage.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such action, or no financial effect. Excluding Facebook is a real narrowing and makes the claim harder rather than easier, which is worth noting.

mentions.claim_text: He responds to a report that when they do work they may lead to unforeseen medical complications further down the line, saying the Lord warned them and he said it is coming and they gave this word well over a year ago, that he said to watch what they are going to do in laboratories, that he saw them in labs creating babies in a lab and being able to make them strong with athletic capabilities.
mentions.quote: they create babies in a lab and they and they're able to make them strong
mentions.falsify_match: Reported embryo selection or editing for physical traits, postdating the word.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reporting predates it. Well over a year ago is vague at the origin end, which is the end that matters here, and embryo screening had been publicly discussed for years before the stated date.
